exposure: severity of RDS (based on PaO2/FiO2 ratio)
outcome: plasma level of soluble receptors for advanced glycation end-products (sRAGE)
cohort: The study included 43 preterm infants diagnosed with RDS and 10 healthy preterm neonate infants as controls.
finding: Preterm infants with RDS had significantly higher plasma levels of sRAGE and AQP5 compared to healthy controls, and these levels increased with the severity of RDS.
